description: Fetch a single brand truth by ID. short {id,name,type,pinned}; medium adds personaScope+tags+summary+timestamps; full = raw (includes full content). Use detail='full' to retrieve the complete content body.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "full". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

id.description: Brand truth entry ID to retrieve.

name: brand_truth_get
